authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Ordered components ek + sarka/harka: CDIAL 2462 subsection 2 *ekka explicitly gives Hindi and Gujarati ek one. CDIAL 13119 sadṛkṣa like explicitly supplies Prakrit sarikkha/sārikkha, Punjabi sarkhā, Hindi sarikā/sarīkhā, Old Marwari sārikho and Gujarati sarkhũ. Selected western sarka/harka responses match this comparative family, with s/h realization, aspiration variation and final vowels retained as qualifications. The same gloss denotes likeness/equivalence; local Indo-Aryan transmission is unresolved. Both lexical components of the response are linked, preserving source spacing and inflection; this is not a reconstructed ancient compound. Exact response: ek harko.
